title: Yummy Fluffy Spanish Chicken Crema Catalana
description: A briny, fluffy Spanish custard with a subtle chicken bouillon twist that feels nostalgic and protein-packed.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together egg yolks, sugar, vanilla extract, and chicken bouillon powder until smooth.
Heat milk and heavy cream in a saucepan until it reaches a simmer, then pour over the egg mixture while whisking constantly.
Stir in the cinnamon stick, lemon zest, and salt.
Transfer the mixture to a pressure cooker, add the flour and stir until no lumps.
Seal the pressure cooker, cook on high pressure for 10 minutes, then allow natural release for 5 minutes.
Remove the pressure cooker, discard the cinnamon stick, and skim off any fat from the surface.
Transfer the custard to a heatproof bowl, cover with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming.
Let it cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours until thickened.
Before serving, sprinkle lightly with additional sugar and zest if desired.
Spoon into ramekins and serve chilled for a creamy, nostalgic treat.
